description: Manual demo action sequence for the current MockWorldService (contracts/fixture_mock_world.json); educational mock, not live Perceptron evidence

actions.name: Start Disaster
actions.expected_result: Phase changes to disaster_active, hazard overlay appears

actions.name: Place Person in Eastern Village
actions.expected_result: Person token is accepted; the mock does not calculate unmet needs

actions.name: Place Hospital on West Side
actions.expected_result: Hospital token is accepted; real medical reachability requires the authoritative world service

actions.name: Place Food & Water Station
actions.expected_result: Token is accepted at its matching service site

actions.name: Place Emergency Shelter
actions.expected_result: Token is accepted at its matching service site

actions.name: Request Bridge Suggestion
actions.expected_result: Action is acknowledged without a version change; POST /plan/suggest returns a bridge suggestion at crossing_east

actions.name: Place Bridge at Ghost Location
actions.expected_result: Bridge is accepted, the mock crossing is unblocked, and mock blocked_roads becomes zero; service improvements require the authoritative world service

notes: Start with a fresh MockWorldService at world_version 1.
All six token placements are included; no pre-staged tokens are required.
For live or P4 WorldService replay, use the current snapshot version and that scenario's approved site coordinates; these coordinates target backend/api/mock_world.py.
The suggest action is supported without changing world_version. The current mock action handler acknowledges it; POST /plan/suggest returns the suggestion.
Mock acceptance does not verify routing or service improvements; use scenarios/nepal_rasuwa_v1/data/demo_actions.json for the authoritative world demonstration.
